BiblicalUsage: Paul quotes Psalm 68 when he says Christ led captivity captive — the ascended Lord takes His defeated enemies as His train of captives and gives gifts to men. Revelation uses the same word the other way round: he that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity, a warning that persecutors will share the fate they inflict.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this word turns captivity inside out. Christ does not merely free prisoners; He parades the powers that held us, and the church's gifts — apostles, prophets, teachers — are the spoils of His victory.
